scripts.test: npm test -w nucleo && npm test -w plataforma
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w nucleo && npm run lint -w plataforma
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w nucleo && npm run typecheck -w plataforma
scripts.docker:subir: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file plataforma/.env.local --profile completo up -d --build
scripts.docker:parar: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file plataforma/.env.local --profile completo stop
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file plataforma/.env.local --profile completo logs -f plataforma
